title: Atbash (Ciphers)
body:
## This pack is Atbash!

For the third in my seiries of ciphers I give you the Atbash cipher! **NOW WITH MOD SUPPORT!!!**

This covers every string in the game exept the credit files. i want to do those as well but it will take a bit longer.
